stratification: train-first coverage of every location class present in the data, then test coverage for classes with >=2 patients, then val coverage for classes with >=3 patients, then iterative stratification on location class + centre/modality + aneurysm-presence and their crossings, then a swap-repair pass that tightens centre and positive/negative balance without losing coverage
notes: 9 of 52 location classes have zero annotated cases in the released training data, so no split can contain them: 3 (R-1.2 PICA trunk), 9 (R-1.6 AICA trunk), 10 (L-1.6 AICA trunk), 12 (L-1.7 BA-AICA junction), 13 (R-1.8 SCA trunk), 14 (L-1.8 SCA trunk), 18 (R-2.1 P1P2), 20 (R-2.2 P3P4), 52 (L-5.3 Distal-M2M3)

Train covers every location class that exists in the data. Classes with only one annotated patient were given to train (a class the model never sees is a class it can never predict); they are therefore absent from val and test.
